reasoning: A polished Arabic RTL real-estate workspace and customer-facing showcase. Keep agent workflows fast, public listing pages safe to share, and business branding configurable for the office.

rtl_guidelines.tailwind_logical_properties: Mandatory. Use 'ps-' (padding start), 'pe-' (padding end), 'ms-' (margin start), 'me-' (margin end) instead of 'pl', 'pr', 'ml', 'mr'.
rtl_guidelines.icons: Ensure directional arrows (back/forward) are rotated for RTL using 'rtl:rotate-180' or switched explicitly.

rules: Use clear, readable Arabic text; reserve heavier weights for headings, labels, and actions.
Avoid tight letter spacing in Arabic.
Keep body copy concise and line height comfortable.

colors.contrast_rules: Keep text and controls clearly distinguishable from their backgrounds; show keyboard focus clearly and do not rely on color alone for status.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Clear hierarchy, generous whitespace, and short paths to common agent tasks.

page_layout.container: Use a centered max-width content area with responsive padding.
page_layout.cards: Use white surfaces, restrained borders, soft shadows, and consistent rounded corners.
page_layout.responsive: Keep forms and data cards usable on narrow mobile screens; provide bottom navigation on mobile.

navigation.desktop: Keep properties, customers, appointments, performance, subscriptions, and admin destinations discoverable.
navigation.mobile: Four primary destinations with secondary sections under a clearly labeled More menu.

spacing_and_layout.touch_targets: Aim for at least 44px controls, with larger targets for the most common mobile actions.

inputs.style: Use a clear border, readable value text, visible focus ring, and enough vertical padding for touch.
inputs.labels: Keep explicit labels visible outside inputs.
inputs.error_style: Show a clear error beside the relevant field and explain how to fix it.

buttons.primary: Use the brand color for the main action, with a clear hover, focus, disabled, and loading state.
buttons.secondary: Use a neutral surface and border for supporting actions; keep labels explicit.

cards.style: White surface, subtle border, consistent rounded corners and restrained shadow.
cards.data_cards: Group related metrics and provide a descriptive label for each value.

icons.size: Use 16–24px icons in controls and larger icons only for page headers.
icons.usage: Pair icons with visible text for primary actions; provide accessible labels for icon-only controls.

motion.philosophy: Use brief transitions only when they clarify navigation or feedback.

accessibility.screen_readers: Use semantic landmarks, labels, roles, and Arabic accessible names for icon-only buttons.
accessibility.testing: Add stable data-testid attributes to critical workflows and elements used by automated checks.
accessibility.contrast: Keep text readable on every status and surface.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements need a visible keyboard focus state.

error_messages.style: text-lg font-bold text-states-error flex items-center gap-2 mt-2
error_messages.behavior: Shown immediately on blur or on submit

loading_states.button: Show spinner icon, disable pointer events, keep text visible

empty_states.style: flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center
empty_states.cta_button: Optional primary button to encourage action

success_messages.style: text-lg font-bold text-states-success flex items-center gap-2 mt-2
success_messages.placement: Below input field or top of form

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the existing application with React, Tailwind CSS, and the current component set; preserve its FastAPI and Supabase architecture.
Keep the interface Arabic-first and RTL, with the Tajawal font stack and responsive desktop/mobile layouts.
Use short, familiar Arabic labels. Keep property management, customer leads, follow-up calendar, performance, subscriptions, and admin flows easy to find.
Customer leads are part of the product. Use the stages new, contacted, visit_scheduled, negotiating, won, and lost; scope agent data to the current agent and let admin review all agents.
The follow-up calendar is weekly and uses lead follow_up_at dates. Do not include closed leads in follow-up appointments.
The performance overview uses the authenticated agent scope (or all agents for admin) and reports property status, lead stages, close rate, overdue follow-ups, and six monthly win totals.
Property sharing must omit the owner phone and other private owner information. Support WhatsApp text, copy, and print-to-PDF from a branded preview.
The property map is deferred until the app stores usable coordinates.
Fetch subscription status through the subscriptions API; subscription state is not part of the user record.
Preserve API field names and validation rules in backend/server.py and backend/leads.py. The API base path is /api.
Use explicit input labels, clear loading/error/empty states, responsive touch controls, and visible keyboard focus.
Keep SQL migrations ordered and add a new migration for schema changes already deployed; do not rewrite an applied migration.

crm.map_status: Deferred until property coordinate fields and storage are available.

public_sharing.preview: Backend serves Open Graph and Twitter metadata, then redirects human visitors to the React property detail page.
public_sharing.privacy: Never expose owner name or owner phone in public responses. Agent phone requires explicit consent and public links must be revocable.
public_sharing.image_access: Public shared images are served through a token-checked API route; private agent images continue to require authentication.

commercial_setup.support_contacts: Set REACT_APP_SUPPORT_WHATSAPP and REACT_APP_SUPPORT_INSTAGRAM to the business accounts before opening registration.
commercial_setup.share_domains: Set PUBLIC_API_URL and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to the backend origin and PUBLIC_APP_URL to the frontend origin; all three must use HTTPS in production.
commercial_setup.storage: Use a private Supabase Storage bucket. Apply 20261027000300_storage_provider.sql; keep the legacy Emergent key while old objects still use that provider.
commercial_setup.payments: Paid subscription activation is currently manual; do not present automatic card payment as implemented.
